Mika (Finance): Heads-up — Heliotrope told CS they received two platform-fee line items on their private deployment renewal. One line references 'private_standard' and the other 'private_enterprise_legacy'. Amounts are identical. They opened a compliance review.

Jordan (Billing): Can you paste invoice snippet?

Mika (Finance): From INV-2026-4012:
```
line 1: private_standard | platform fee | $24,000
line 2: private_enterprise_legacy | platform fee | $24,000
```
They paid on 2026-07-01. PO: PO-5543.

Ellie (Sales): We executed a consolidation of SKUs last quarter and created an alias mapping, but sounds like the billing export duplicated both entries during the transition. Customer says there was no contract change.

Samir (RevOps): Our billing export currently includes any active sku_tags present in the account at snapshot time. If aliasing wasn't collapsed by revops sync, both tags show. Looks like the migration window overlapped billing cut. Filing internal ticket BILL-9577.

billing-bot: Invoice INV-2026-4012 status: PAID. Note: billing snapshot included sku_tags [private_standard, private_enterprise_legacy].

Nina (Customer Success): Customer needs corrected invoice for audit and a refund for the duplicated platform fee. They requested the replacement invoice to reference their CO-H-2023 contract.

Jordan (Billing): Since this is a duplicate label with identical amounts, propose issuing credit CN-2026-0125 for $24,000 and creating replacement INV-2026-4012-R with a single platform-fee line using canonical sku 'private_standard' and memo "SKU alias overlap - replaced per internal BILL-9577". Apply payment to replacement so no net refund if customer prefers.

Ellie (Sales): Customer prefers replacement invoice tied to the original payment. Sales approves the replacement flow. Please cc me and CS in the notice.

Mika (Finance): Approve. Also request engineering add a dedupe pass to the invoice generator to collapse alias pairs before rendering.

Samir (RevOps): Will add a preflight that maps aliases to canonical sku and de-duplicates identical platform fee lines. Assigning BILL-9577 to eng-billing.

Jordan (Billing): Creating CN-2026-0125 and replacement INV-2026-4012-R now. Memo: "Refund/replace for duplicate platform fee due to SKU alias overlap. See BILL-9577." ETA 24h.

billing-bot: CN-2026-0125 created and applied; INV-2026-4012-R generated. Payment reapplied.

Nina (Customer Success): Customer confirmed replacement invoice received and compliance check passed. They appreciate the quick turnaround.

Mika (Finance): Closing. Will include SKU alias check in renewal playbook and follow up on BILL-9577 RCA.
